title: landing.made@1
description: A step of landing in turn (#1331; design: Landing in turn), one event per step, appended by the core alone: a change judged on its merge with the default branch's head (its verdict's commit and tree), sent back to its own attempt with the files that conflict, held for a result other than PASS, landed through the forge with the commit main took, stopped when the default branch read back holds another tree than the verdict covered, or a pull request from before the run joined as its issue's attempt.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

step.description: Which step: judged on the merge with the head; sent back, conflicting; held, its verdict not a PASS; landed; stopped, the read-back differing; joined, an earlier pull request as the attempt.

x-closure.closed: each value is a step of landing in turn the design names
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

pr.description: The pull request kept as the change's thread.

head.description: The pull request's head when the step happened.

main.description: The default branch's head the step read.

commit.description: judged: the merge of head and main the verdict covers; landed: the commit the default branch took; stopped: the commit read back.

claim.description: The claim the change was judged as.

outcome.description: The verdict the step read, or none for a step that reads no verdict.

x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

files.description: sent_back: the files that conflict; stopped: the files whose contents differ.

open.description: landed: the requirements only the budget window can settle, which its issue names while it stays open.
